title: Download the Completed Website
summary: Resource lecture offering the finished drum kit project as a download so the learner can compare it with their own build.

concepts.heading: Using the download
points: Use the Resources button on this lecture to get the completed drum kit (HTML, CSS, JS, images and sounds).
Compare it against your own version only after attempting the build, especially script.js (makeSound, buttonAnimation) and the .pressed rule in styles.css.
(Extra) The reference repo's version of this project lives in the 18.09 folder and has the keydown listener, makeSound and buttonAnimation.
